title: openssl rsa -modulus segfaults: bn_expand_internal: Assertion `b->top <= words' failed
root_cause: Uninitialized BIGNUM variable 'n' passed to EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param
notes: Candidate C harness translated from CLI PoC. Strict reproduction requires the original certificate input.
validation_notes: The generated C harness was translated from the original CLI command `openssl x509 -noout -modulus -in /tmp/httpd.crt`. It compiled and executed successfully using a placeholder local certificate copied from the system CA bundle. The harness extracted and printed the RSA modulus through X509_get_pubkey, EVP_PKEY_get1_RSA, RSA_get0_key and BN_print_fp. Valgrind reported 0 errors. This validates the harness structure and API path, but does not strictly reproduce the original issue because the original /tmp/httpd.crt input has not been recovered.
